title: Reverie album
description: This music pack replace all standart in-game background music (except menu) with 6 tracks by melody amaranth valentyne.
body:
This music pack replace all standart in-game background OST (except menu) with 6 soundtracks by melody amaranth valentyne.

### How to install: 
download zip archive with needed version -> put archive in .minecraft\resourcepacks -> launch game and activate the pack -> done :D

### Used soundtracks:
1. centennial
2. eminence
3. haven
4. 4thcoming
5. apropos
6. reverie


More details and all links to author in credits.txt
